regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and article metadata
regions.finding: Article identity and the high-level statement of moderate yields/up to 96% ee were inspected; these aggregate claims are not independent experiments.
The prose distinguishes prior chiral-ligand/chiral-amine studies and introduces the limitations summarized in Scheme 1; cited work was not reclassified as new experiments.

Four specific preliminary/prior examples were read row-by-row: 4aa (46%, 98% ee), 4bb with ZnI2 (26% NMR yield), 4bb with ZnBr2 (31%, 82% ee), and trace 4cc by 1H NMR. They are classified as literature examples.
The TBS-protected earlier-work arrow and the current-report arrow use generic R groups and aggregate ranges; each is classified as a general scheme, not an individual experiment.

unresolved: The prior examples omit scale, atmosphere, workup, purification, and some analytical bases.
Generic Scheme 1b-c structures and ranges cannot be assigned to unique experiments.
No Supporting Information file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table S1 reproduction narrative
regions.finding: The current authors report inability to reproduce Periasamy's yield/ee for 1d/2b across several ZnBr2 sources. One partial summary record is retained; absent Table S1 entries 1-5 are not invented.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1-5, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Five distinct time/preheating experiments were retained with quantities, preheating override, isolated yields, chiral-HPLC ee, and the entry-1 contamination ratio 4db:1d = 1:3.17.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1-6, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Six distinct stoichiometry optimization experiments were retained with exact mmol ratios, Ar/sequential-addition conditions, two-stage heating, isolated yield, and chiral-HPLC ee.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 3 reaction drawing, rows 1-13, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Thirteen distinct substrate-scope rows were retained and linked to their detailed section 4.2 preparations on pages 3-5; no rows were merged by shared product class.

unresolved: Table S1 is absent, so the five ZnBr2-source rows and their numerical outcomes cannot be reconstructed.
Tables 1-2 omit workup, purification, and isolated masses.
All candidate structures and axial assignments remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left conclusion and General remarks
regions.finding: Conclusion and instrument/material-handling context were reviewed; commercial reagent sources and solvent drying are not separate reactions.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left section 4.2.1 typical procedure for (R)-4db
regions.finding: Detailed 1.0 mmol ZnBr2/(S)-3, 1.5 mmol 1d, 2.0 mmol 2b procedure, staged heating, workup, chromatography, 95.8 mg, 42%, 94% ee, and HPLC conditions were merged with Table 3 entry 1.
Detailed preparations of 4dd, 4de, and 4df plus the start of cross-page 4dg were merged with Table 3 entries 2-5; characterization text was not turned into extra reactions.

unresolved: The typical workup is applied to later compounds because the source explicitly says they were prepared according to it; entry-specific deviations beyond printed eluents are unavailable.
Corresponding racemic preparations refer to external report 5 and were not imported.

regions.finding: The cross-page 4dg preparation completes with 102.5 mg, 39%, 90% ee and HPLC conditions; merged with Table 3 entry 5.
Detailed preparations 4dh, 4di, and 4dj were merged with Table 3 entries 6-8, including masses, isolated yields, ee, and HPLC conditions.
Detailed preparations 4dk, 4dl, and 4bb plus the start of cross-page 4eb were merged with Table 3 entries 9-12.

unresolved: Spectral characterization is source support for compound identity but is not modeled as an additional reaction record.
Axial stereochemistry is retained in labels and remains unverified in candidate SMILES.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left completion of 4.2.12 and section 4.2.13
regions.finding: The 4eb preparation completes with 87.8 mg, 44%, 95% ee; the separate 4fm experiment gives 139.8 mg, 58%, 98% ee. Both are merged with Table 3 entries 12 and 13.

The authors identify internal reproductions of Table S1 entry 1 and Table 3 entries 2, 4, and 10. These are linked as supporting context, not duplicated because no independent quantities or outcomes are supplied.
The paper points to online spectra, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated; no SI-derived facts were inferred.
Bibliography and comments on discrepant optical rotations/racemization literature were reviewed as context; cited external papers were not expanded into current-paper records.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgements do not supply separate run conditions or numerical outcomes.
Table S2 and online spectra are unavailable and unassociated.
